policies.title: Returns and mask exchanges
policies.summary: Complete mask systems have a 60-night return or exchange option. Separately purchased cushions, frames, and headgear are excluded, and a mask style that has already been exchanged and repurchased is not eligible again.

facts.label: Repeat exchange
facts.value: The same repurchased mask style is not eligible again

facts.label: LoftaCare

policies.title: Prescription requirements
policies.summary: Prescription-required products cannot ship until a valid prescription is verified. Lofta offers a home sleep test for new patients and an RxExpress renewal service for existing PAP users.

policies.title: Insurance and health spending accounts
policies.summary: Lofta's standard store is cash-only and does not bill private insurance directly. HSA and FSA funds are accepted. A separate pathway can coordinate testing and treatment information with Apria for possible insurance coverage.

policies.title: Shipping

policies.title: Returns and mask assurance
policies.summary: All CPAP masks are covered by a 60-day assurance policy. Unopened masks can be refunded to the original payment method; opened masks receive store credit, minus shipping and discounts. The benefit can be used once every six months.

facts.label: Unopened mask
facts.value: Refund to original payment method, excluding shipping

facts.label: Opened mask
facts.value: 100% store credit, minus shipping and discounts

policies.title: Prescription requirements
policies.summary: Complete CPAP masks and PAP machines require a prescription; individual replacement parts do not. RespShop offers assistance retrieving, renewing, or obtaining a prescription.

sources.title: Can I buy a CPAP mask without a prescription?

policies.title: Insurance and health spending accounts
policies.summary: RespShop provides claim forms, invoices, and reimbursement guidance for customers who self-file with an insurer. HSA and FSA cards can be used for eligible CPAP purchases; coverage depends on the customer's plan.

facts.label: Documents

facts.label: HSA / FSA

facts.label: Coverage

policies.title: Clinical and shopping support

methodology.reviews: Counts use the merged retailer mask-review corpus. Eligibility follows the existing mask publishing rules.
methodology.serviceClaims: Only exact-evidence claims from service-scoped extractions and the approved service taxonomy are included. Each review contributes once per service aspect.
methodology.serviceScore: The score is the mean 0–10 service-claim sentiment after averaging within each review, scaled to 0–100. It is evidence context, not a universal retailer grade.
methodology.policies: Policy summaries were reviewed against official retailer pages on the displayed verification date. Users should confirm terms with the retailer before purchase.
